# Elias Purdy MacKinnon

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Regent’s Class Is Organized P33](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P17](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0017), [v3 ch.Relationships P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Elias Purdy MacKinnon is a comical-looking youth with a massive, circular chubby face and tiny blue eyes. His ears flare out like flaps and are notably repulsive.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Regent’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

Elias Purdy MacKinnon is an exceptionally solemn young man. His primary goal is to become a minister, though he has noted that working as a carpenter would be a simpler pursuit.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Regent’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P20](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0020), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P41](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0041)_

## History

Elias Purdy MacKinnon originally aspired to become a minister. After departing Regent's, he went on to work as a schoolteacher.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Regent’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v3 ch.Relationships P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004)_

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/elias-purdy-mackinnon--nell-harcourt.md)

Elias Purdy MacKinnon and [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) are schoolmates who share a friendship and discuss their anxieties surrounding exams. Though they share this academic connection, Nell's broader journey includes preparing for her entrance exams under Miss [Thorne](../character/thorne.md) and eventually tying for first place on the island. She later navigates personal losses and attends a farewell gathering alongside peers like Hugh before heading off to college.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Regent’s Class Is Organized P4](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Regent’s Class Is Organized P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Regent’s Class Is Organized P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016), +18 more_
